summary.note: Informational projection of the contract and receipt; only the statement and manifest are cryptographically bound.
summary.objective: Let a delegator accept another agent's work only on evidence (docs/PROTOCOL_SPEC.md Section 8): evidence-verify --brief <task-brief.json> verifies the range as the delivery for that brief, failing when the brief's task has no intact bundle, when covered paths leave allowedPaths or touch readOnlyPaths, or when a brief verification item has no passing bound check; implement the same in the independent verifier and make Section 8 normative.
successCriteria: evidence-verify --brief rejects missing evidence, scope violations and unmet brief verification
Both verifiers pass the delegation conformance cases
